# FBHS Fiscal 2017 Debt Figures

## Key Figures

- **$1,250 million revolving credit agreement due June 2021 (2017):** $615.0 million
- **Total debt (2017):** $1,507.6 million
- **$500 million unsecured senior note due June 2025 (2017):** $494.3 million
- **$400 million unsecured senior note due June 2020 (2017):** $398.3 million

## Calculation

To find the percent of the total debt associated with the $1,250 million revolving credit agreement due June 2021:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{615.0}{1,507.6} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = 40.79\% \]

## Source Files

- **$1,250 million revolving credit agreement due June 2021 (2017):** `documents/report.md`
- **Total debt (2017):** `documents/report.md`
- **$500 million unsecured senior note due June 2025 (2017):** `documents/report.md`
- **$400 million unsecured senior note due June 2020 (2017):** `documents/report.md`

All figures are from the FBHS fiscal 2017 annual report (10-K), page 76.
